protocol: Before changing the stop policy, replay all 45 original first-stop states separately for bounded and free skill, fixed checkpoint and deterministic decoder. Cross stop-letter A/B with presentation order A/B or B/A. Original skill, draft, evidence and five-neighbor counts held fixed. Bounded skill additionally with image and without retrieval counts. Among 23 whose base router continued, score all observed repaired-base prefixes with same reader and judge. Separate original trusted first draft from all-evidence first draft. No new patient data or tool requests required.
